description.text: A concept pack of the XY BREAK series released on 16 July 2016, the day Volcanion's film opened, holding only mythical and legendary Pokémon, every one of them holo. Each four-card pack held a Pokémon-EX or a card drawn across the whole card, such as Celebi. Volcanion and Magearna from the film lead, with Darkrai, Mew, Jirachi, Genesect, Arceus and others. The cards are numbered to 36, followed by Yveltal-EX and Xerneas-EX.
